# FastAgent

> The open-source TypeScript cloud runtime for production AI agents. Write agents in Markdown (`SYSTEM.md`, `AGENTS.md`, `skills/`), typed TypeScript tools, and MCP (built for humans and coding agents), compile them into versioned npm packages (`fastagent build`), and embed in Next.js, Hono, Express, or Fastify keeping your own auth and PostgreSQL database, self-host with Docker, or deploy sleep-when-idle on Fly.io and Railway with durable sessions (SQLite / PostgreSQL), idempotent webhooks (`POST /v1/invoke`), OS sandboxing (`--harness dsh`), remote OAuth auth, and OpenTelemetry traces.

Key facts:

- Install: `npm i -g @fastagent-sh/fastagent` (CLI) or `npm i @fastagent-sh/fastagent` (library). Requires Node >= 22.18 (Node 24/26 LTS recommended) or Bun >= 1.4.4. Inside an agent directory, global `fastagent` delegates to the agent's installed version; otherwise use `npx @fastagent-sh/fastagent <command>` (never `npx fastagent`).
- Agent directory: marked by `fastagent.config.ts` (`defineAgent`): `SYSTEM.md`, `AGENTS.md`, `skills/`, `prompts/`, portable tools in `src/tools/` (`defineTool` from `@fastagent-sh/fastagent` supporting Zod v4 / Standard JSON Schema v1 or plain JSON Schema `as const`), and `pi-durable` extensions in `src/extensions/`. `fastagent build` compiles into `dist/`.
- Contract: the [Agent API](https://github.com/fastagent-sh/fastagent/blob/main/docs/agent-api.md) in process (`openAgent`) and over HTTP (`connectAgent` from `@fastagent-sh/client`, `connectAuth` from `@fastagent-sh/client/auth`, zero Node deps): sessions (create, get, list, update, delete, fork, cancel, compact, entries, events, attachments), durable messages (`send`, `stream`, `get`), single-call `POST /v1/invoke` with caller-named `conversation` (scale-to-zero friendly, `wait` up to 600s), and remote provider auth (`/v1/auth/*`, persisted in durable instance storage). Served under `/v1` when `FASTAGENT_API_KEY` is set; `GET /health` is public.
- Packages (3, single version): `@fastagent-sh/fastagent`, `@fastagent-sh/client`, `@fastagent-sh/harness-dsh`.
- Core CLI: `fastagent [-C <dir>] init | login | logout | dev | invoke | info | models | build | start | deploy | remote` (`deploy init docker|compose|fly|railway`, `deploy check [--json]`, `remote list|add|remove|default`). Coding agents verify with `fastagent info --json`, `fastagent login <provider/model-id> --check`, `fastagent invoke [--json] [--session <id>] [--conversation <name>] [--remote <name>]`, and `fastagent deploy check --json`.

## Start here

- [Repository](https://github.com/fastagent-sh/fastagent): project overview, install, and product paths.
- [AI-guided start](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/fastagent-sh/fastagent/main/docs/ai-start.md): executable instructions for a coding agent.
- [Documentation index](https://github.com/fastagent-sh/fastagent/blob/main/docs/README.md): full documentation map.

## Guides

- [Overview](https://github.com/fastagent-sh/fastagent/blob/main/docs/overview.md): product goals, positioning, core concepts, and boundaries.
- [Technical architecture](https://github.com/fastagent-sh/fastagent/blob/main/docs/architecture.md): system layers, package boundaries, dual harnesses, storage & fencing, security, and OTLP observability.
- [Quickstart](https://github.com/fastagent-sh/fastagent/blob/main/docs/quickstart.md): scaffold, invoke, add a portable tool, build, and run.
- [Packaging, Distribution & CI/CD](https://github.com/fastagent-sh/fastagent/blob/main/docs/packaging-and-ci.md): compile into versioned ESM npm packages (`dist/`), `peerDependencies` sharing, `npm publish`, and `--json` CI gates.
- [Agent development guide](https://github.com/fastagent-sh/fastagent/blob/main/docs/ai-start.md): step-by-step build, test, and deploy workflow for humans and coding agents.
- [Configuration](https://github.com/fastagent-sh/fastagent/blob/main/docs/configuration.md): `fastagent.config.ts`, harnesses & OS sandboxing, models & custom providers, secrets (`needs`), PostgreSQL, coding tools, and OTLP traces.
- [MCP servers](https://github.com/fastagent-sh/fastagent/blob/main/docs/mcp.md): local stdio and remote Streamable HTTP MCP tool servers.
- [Remotes & clients](https://github.com/fastagent-sh/fastagent/blob/main/docs/remotes.md): `fastagent remote`, `remotes.json`, remote `login`/`logout`, and `@fastagent-sh/client`.
- [CLI reference](https://github.com/fastagent-sh/fastagent/blob/main/docs/cli.md): every command, flag, exit code, and automation rule.
- [Embedding](https://github.com/fastagent-sh/fastagent/blob/main/docs/embedding.md): `openAgent`, `openPostgresDatabase`, `service.fetch`, and framework mounts.
- [Deploy](https://github.com/fastagent-sh/fastagent/blob/main/docs/deploy.md): Docker, Docker Compose, Fly.io, Railway, scale-to-zero `POST /v1/invoke`, and `deploy check`.
- [Troubleshooting](https://github.com/fastagent-sh/fastagent/blob/main/docs/troubleshooting.md): common setup, harness, remote, auth, and deployment issues.

## Reference

- [Agent API](https://github.com/fastagent-sh/fastagent/blob/main/docs/agent-api.md): sessions, messages, `POST /v1/invoke`, streaming, remote auth, errors, and HTTP routes.
- [API reference](https://github.com/fastagent-sh/fastagent/blob/main/docs/api-reference.md): all packages and public TypeScript entry points.
- [Contributing](https://github.com/fastagent-sh/fastagent/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md): branch model, PR loop, and review policy.
- [Security policy](https://github.com/fastagent-sh/fastagent/security/policy): vulnerability reporting and credential/isolation model.
